real_life_notes: One of the five hijackers of IC-814 (Indian Airlines Flight 814, December 1999). Known by multiple aliases. Eventually based in Karachi. Killed in an unclaimed hit in Karachi in 2022 — method and perpetrator officially unknown. The film's opening hijack negotiation scene in Kandahar is directly inspired by IC-814.
objective: Execute terror operations for JeM/LeT handlers; maintain Karachi safe harbour for regional jihadi networks
film_relevance: Zahoor appears in Film 1 as a link between the IC-814 legacy (opening scene) and the Lyari network that Hamza is infiltrating — he bridges the 1999 hijack plot to the 2008 attack network.
real_death_notes: Killed Karachi 2022, unclaimed. The film likely depicts this as an Indian intelligence operation, consistent with its hawkish narrative.
